description: ObjectKeyJson contract between the SaaS planner (code/srv/srv/utils/activation-plan.js, objectKey) and the ABAP dispatcher (abap/src/activate/zcl_ado_activate.clas.abap). 'planned' holds the key deriveActivationSteps emits per StepType for 'input' (first step of each type); 'other' holds keys built by objectKey outside the planner. Key NAMES are the contract (camelCase on the wire, snake_case in the ABAP types); values are illustrative - the BSP application name is an example, real ones come from BackendCatalogApps. activation-plan.test.js checks the planner against this file, activation-key-contract.test.js checks the ABAP dispatcher types and the zado_activate_smoke scenarios against it. See docu/09-activation-and-transport/object-key-contract.md.

rollbackRole.note: rollbackActivationStep sends ROLLBACK_<StepType> with a reduced key; ABAP deletes the role verify-first/verify-after.

rollbackProfile.note: The profile is dropped with its role; the ABAP side answers SUCCESS with nothing to undo.

roleOnPlanTransport.note: At dispatch time the engine (withPlanTrkorr) fills trkorr on CREATE_PFCG_ROLE and APPEND_TO_TRANSPORT with the request the plan's ADD_TO_TRANSPORT step created.

icfNodeWithoutCatalogRow.note: Second app of the input has no BspApplication: the key travels empty and the ABAP dispatcher fails fast before HTTP_ACTIVATE_NODE.

transportRelease.note: releaseTransport action: a TRKORR turns ADD_TO_TRANSPORT into a release (simulation = TRINT_RELEASE_REQUEST IV_SIMULATION).

assignRoleToUsers.note: Emitted when a plan has AssignUsers (client-local, never transported).
